mutability_rule: Append-only; a later run binds a new artifact/environment and does not rewrite this dossier.

receipts.expected: purl, immutable source revision and content digest resolve to the exact donor bytes
receipts.observed: The adaptation base is 837a5c2 and backend base is 4b5d792; the verified browser artifact was rebuilt from immutable package checkout d1dca9f, whose frontend tree is under frontend/.
receipts.falsifier: A source receipt resolves v0.27.3 to a commit and the digest matches the retained artifact.
receipts.limitations: No source checkout is shipped or executed by this package.

receipts.expected: The chosen shape preserves donor ownership and avoids source copying while retaining the proven authenticated frame seam.
receipts.observed: The proven SISO Knowledge implementation mounts a compiled same-document module and binds its donor-native backend/data runtime.
receipts.falsifier: The donor requires source edits or the frame cannot carry the host session without a second login.
receipts.limitations: This is a reconstructed decision; this package did not launch the donor runtime.

receipts.expected: A source-copied package would carry a complete transitive closure.
receipts.observed: No donor source or runtime image is copied into this block; donor closure remains the donor runtime's responsibility.
receipts.falsifier: The block contains donor source, compiled runtime or an untracked dependency artifact.
receipts.limitations: The donor runtime's own closure is not qualified here.

receipts.expected: Manifest, seven records, environment config and generated binding satisfy the local package validator.
receipts.observed: Validated by the post-write package smoke in this run.
receipts.falsifier: Any required record reference, contract field or generated binding invariant fails validation.
receipts.limitations: Local validator is not a production admission system.

receipts.expected: The exact donor runtime and any changed/copied files have a usable rights boundary.
receipts.observed: Official native artifact provenance was retained; the historical extracted backend/native source gate is BLOCKED and the web/portal adapter is not proven.
receipts.falsifier: A current official CE web/service receipt supplies file manifest, SBOM and notices and clears the runtime boundary.
receipts.limitations: No legal interpretation or source redistribution is made by this package.

receipts.expected: The package contains only host-side contract and binding logic.
receipts.observed: Static package boundary has no AFFiNE source, runtime image, absolute client path or embedded secret.
receipts.falsifier: A donor source file, runtime binary, secret value or absolute client path is found under the package.
receipts.limitations: Static boundary does not prove donor runtime behaviour.

receipts.expected: Identity, workspace, route, settings, health, files, events and observability ports are typed and linked.
receipts.observed: The TypeScript interface and generated fixture binding expose each required seam.
receipts.falsifier: A required host seam is only prose or a generated binding omits it.
receipts.limitations: Types are not a runtime acceptance proof.

receipts.expected: A second host identity cannot read or write the selected workspace.
receipts.observed: The binding requires host-selected workspace identity and refuses mismatch; no two-identity donor run was executed.
receipts.falsifier: A cross-workspace or cross-tenant result is observed.
receipts.limitations: SISO Knowledge's disposable harness explicitly did not prove second-user isolation.

receipts.expected: A disposable host fixture generates a deterministic frame route and refuses invalid identity.
receipts.observed: The local smoke exercises valid generation, client mismatch, expiry, missing identity, config parsing and install materialization.
receipts.falsifier: A negative fixture produces a binding or a valid fixture produces a different route.
receipts.limitations: Synthetic fixture only; no client data or external runtime.

receipts.expected: Local install, bind and validate commands run deterministically without donor execution.
receipts.observed: Post-write smoke passes in a disposable directory.
receipts.falsifier: The command requires network, source checkout, credentials or a long-lived runtime.
receipts.limitations: No donor build/start/health check was run by this package.

receipts.expected: The framed workspace remains usable at desktop and mobile viewport classes.
receipts.observed: Historical desktop/mobile screenshots exist for the client integration; no new package surface was rendered.
receipts.falsifier: A current host pilot fails frame sizing, focus, keyboard, or mobile acceptance.
receipts.limitations: No visual or accessibility claim is made for this package.

receipts.expected: Only configured donor, companion and server origins receive runtime traffic, with no secret in URL or frame query.
receipts.observed: The generated binding rejects non-configured frame messages and carries assertion by runtime handoff rather than query parameter.
receipts.falsifier: A generated route contains an assertion or an event from an unexpected origin is accepted.
receipts.limitations: No browser/network egress run was executed.

receipts.expected: Code, config, route, donor revision and donor data recovery objects can be restored independently.
receipts.observed: The release record enumerates those objects and keeps the recovery horizon at zero until rehearsed.
receipts.falsifier: A rollback restores code while leaving another release object at the new version.
receipts.limitations: No deploy or rollback was authorized or executed.

receipts.expected: A named human admits an exact capability/version/host scope only after all required evidence families pass.
receipts.observed: No admission was requested or performed; registry scope arrays are empty and release status is DRAFT.
receipts.falsifier: A package artifact is represented as admitted for a tenant, application or environment.
receipts.limitations: This dispatch explicitly forbids claiming admission.

observed_gates: same-document host mount and semantic health
ordered donor unmount before host DOM cleanup
held_gates: rights, mobile/accessibility, upgrade replay, rollback rehearsal and human admission

minimum_tier_rule: evidence_tier is the minimum across the nine orthogonal families; no family pass is derived from another family.
